How Is a Ladder with Zero Fall Accidents Made? Korea’s Safety Ladder Manufacturing Process

Hello, this is King Process.
From apartment exterior work to high altitude maintenance, ladders are used at countless job sites. However, even a small slip or wobble while working can lead to a serious fall accident.
This video shows how New One Industry manufactures a ladder safety platform designed to improve the narrow steps of conventional ladders and provide workers with more stable footing. Enjoy watching the entire process, from metalworking and component production to assembly and final completion.
